verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अथ तत्र महार्चिष्माननलो वातसारथिः । तस्याविदूरे रक्षार्थं खगेन्द्रेण कृतोऽभवत् ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said On one occasion, while living in the hermitage of Nara and Narayana, Narada the son of Prameshthi, having duly performed the rites and observances in honour of the gods, began to perforin thereafter the rites in honour of the departed manes.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि पार्श्वे सुष्वाप विश्वस्तो बकराट् तदा । कृतघ्नस्तु स दुष्टात्मा तं जिघांसुरथाग्रतः ॥२॥
verses.english: Beholding him thus prepared, the eldest son of Dharma, viz., the powerful Narayana, addressed him, saying,-Whom you adoring, O foremost of twice-born ones, by these rites and the observances in connection with the gods and the departed means. O foremost of all persons gifted with intelligence, tell me this, agreeably to the scriptures. What is this that you are doing? What also are the fruits desired by you of those rites which you are performing. are

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽलातेन दीप्तेन निःश्वस्तं निजघान तम् । निहत्य च मुदा युक्तः सोऽनुबन्धं न दृष्टवान् ॥३॥
verses.english: Narada said You said to me formerly that rites and observances in honour of the gods should be performed. You said that the rites in honour of the gods from the highest sacrifice and are equivalent to the worship of the Eternal and Supreme Soul.

verses.sanskrit: स तं विपक्षरोमाणं कृत्वाऽग्नावपचत्तदा । तं गृहीत्वा सुवर्णं व ययौ द्रुततरं द्विजः ॥४॥
verses.english: Thus instructed, I always sacrifice in honour of the eternal and iminutable Vishnu through these rites that I perform in adoring the gods. It is from that Supreme Deity that Brahman, the Grandfather of all the worlds, sprang in days of yore.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽन्यस्मिन् गते चाह्नि विरुपाक्षोऽब्रवीत्सुतम् । न प्रेक्षे राजधर्माणमद्य पुत्र खगोत्तमम् ॥५॥
verses.english: That Brahman, otherwise called Prameshthi, filled with cheerfulness, caused my father (Daksha) to come into being. I was the son of Brahman, created before all others, by his will.

verses.sanskrit: स पूर्वसंध्यां ब्रह्माणं वन्दितुं याति सर्वदा । मां वा दृष्ट्वा कदाचित्स न गच्छति गृहं खगः ॥६॥
verses.english: Orighteous and illustrious one, I am performing these rites in honour of the departed manes for the sake of Narayana and according to those ordinances that have been ordained by himself. The illustrious Narayana is the father, mother, and grandfather.

verses.sanskrit: उभे द्विरात्रिसंध्ये वै नाभ्यगात्स ममालयम् । तस्मान्न शुद्ध्यते भावो मम स ज्ञायतां सुहृत् ॥७॥
verses.english: In all sacrifices performed in honour of the departed manes, it is that Lord of the universe who is worshipped. On one occasion, the gods, who were father, taught their children the Shrutis.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायेन वियुक्तो हि ब्रह्मवर्चसवर्जितः । तद्व्रतस्तत्र मे शंका हन्यात्तं स द्विजाधमः ॥८॥
verses.english: Having lost their knowledge of the Shrutis, and father had to acquire it again from those sons to whom they had come municated it. On account of this incident, the sons, who had thus to communicate the Mantras to their father, acquired the status of fathers.

verses.sanskrit: दुराचारस्तु दुर्बुद्धिरिङ्गितैर्लक्षितो मया । निष्कृतो दारुणाकारो दुष्टो दस्युरिवाधमः ॥९॥
verses.english: Forsooth, what the gods did on that occasion is well known to you two. Sons and fathers had thus to adore each other.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमः स गतस्तत्र तेनोद्विग्नं मनो मम । पुत्र शीघ्रमितो गत्वा राजधर्मनिवेशनम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Having first spread some blades of Kusha grass, the gods and the departed manes placed three funeral cakes thereon and thus adored each other. I wish to know, however, the reason why the departed manes in days of yore acquired the name of Pindas.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञायतां स विशुद्धात्मा यदि जीवति मा चिरम् । स एवमुक्तस्त्वरितो रक्षोभिः सहितो ययौ ॥११॥
न्यग्रोधं तत्र चापश्यत् कङ्कालं राजधर्मणः । स रुदन्नगमत्पुत्रो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य धीमतः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Nara and Narayana said The Earth, in days of yore, with her belt of seas, disappeared from the view. Govinda, taking the form of a gigantic boar, raised her up.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरमाणः परं शक्त्या गौतमग्रहणाय वै । ततोऽविदूरे जगृहुर्गौतमं राक्षसास्तदा ॥१३॥
verses.english: Having replaced the Earth in her former position, that foremost of Purushas, his body smeared with water and mud, began to do what was necessary for the world and its inhabitants.

verses.sanskrit: राजधर्मशरीरं च पक्षास्थि चरणोज्झितम् । तमादायाथ रक्षांसि द्रुतं मेरुव्रजं ययुः ॥१४॥
verses.english: When the Sun reached the meridian, and the hour, therefore, came for saying the morning prayers, the powerful Lord, suddenly shaking off thrce balls of mud from his tusk, placed them upon the Earth, O Narada, having previously spread powerful Vishnu dedicated those balls of mud to his own self, according to the rites laid down in the eternal ordinance.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञश्च दर्शयामासुः शरीरं राजधर्मणः । कृतघ्नं परुषं तं च गौतमं पापकारिणम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Regarding the three balls of mud that the powerful Lord had shaken off from his tusks as funeral cakes, he then, with sesame seeds that arose from the heat of his own body, himself performed the rite of dedication, sitting with face turned towards the East. That foremost of gods then, moved by the desire of establishing rules of conduct for the inhabitants of the three worlds, said these words.

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद राजा तं दृष्ट्वा सामात्यः सपुरोहितः । आर्तनादश्च सुमहानभूत्तस्य निवेशने ॥१६॥
verses.english: I am the Creator of the worlds. I ain determined to create those that are to be called departed manes.-Saying these words, he began to think of those high ordinances that should regulate the rites to be performed in honour of the departed manes.

verses.sanskrit: सस्त्रीकुमारं च पुरं बभूवास्वस्थमानसम् । अथाब्रवीन्नृपः पुत्रं पापोऽयं वध्यतामिति ॥१७॥
verses.english: While thus doing, he beheld that the three balls of mud, shaken off his tusk, had fallen towards the South. He then said to himself,—These balls, shaken off my tusk, have fallen on the Earth towards the south of her surface! Led by this, I declare that these should be known henceforth by the name of departed manes.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य मांसैरिमे सर्वे विहरन्तु यथेष्टतः । पापाचारः पापकर्मा पापात्मा पापसाधनः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Let these three that are of no particular shape, and that are only round, come to be considered as Pitris in the world! Thus do I create the eternal Pitris.

verses.sanskrit: हन्तव्योऽयं मम मतिर्भवद्भिरिति राक्षसाः । इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसा घोरविक्रमाः ॥१९॥
नैच्छन्त तं भक्षयितुं पापकर्माणमित्युत । दस्यूनां दीयतामेष साध्वद्य पुरुषाधमः ॥२०॥
इत्यूचुस्ते महाराज राक्षसेन्द्रं निशाचराः । शिरोभिः प्रणताः सर्वे व्याहरन् राक्षसाधिपम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: I am the father, the grandfather and the great grandfather, and I should be considered as living in these three Pindas.

verses.sanskrit: न दातुमर्हसि त्वं नो भक्षणायास्य किल्बिषम् । एवमस्त्विति तानाह राक्षसेन्द्रो निशाचरान् ॥२२॥
verses.english: There is no one that is superior to me. Who is there whom I myself may adore with rites? Who, again, is iny father in the universe? I myself am my grandfather.

verses.sanskrit: दस्यूनां दीयतामेष कृतघ्नोऽद्यैव राक्षसाः । इत्युक्ता राक्षसास्तेन शूलपट्टिशपाणयः ॥२३॥
verses.english: I am, indeed, the Grandfather and the father, I am the one cause! Having said these words, that God of gods, viz., He called Vrishakapi, offered those funeral cakes, O learned Brahmana, on the breast of the Varaha mountains, with elaborate rites. By those rites. He adored His own self, and having finished the adoration, disappeared there and then.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तं खण्डशः पापं दस्युभ्यः प्रददुस्तदा । दस्यवश्चापि नैच्छन्त तमत्तुं पापकारिणम् । क्रव्यादा अपि राजेन्द्र कृतघ्नं नोपभुञ्जते ॥२४॥
verses.english: Hence the Pitris are called Pinda. This is the root of the designation. According to the words given vent to by Vrishakapi at that time, the Pitris receive the worship offered by all.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव्रते तथा । निष्कृतिर्विहिता राजन् कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Unaffected by happiness or misery, His attitude towards all is equal. Gifted with greatness, and of great soul, Narayana has been said to be the soul of all things in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रद्रोही कृतघ्नश्च नृशंसश्च नराधमः । क्रव्यादैः कृमिभिश्चैव न भुज्यन्ते हि तादृशाः ॥२६॥
verses.english: That cruel and mean man who does injury to a friend and turns ungrateful, is not eaten even by the very cannibals nor by the worms that feed on carrion.
